cohort: The study included 100 normotensive ASA grade II parturients and 100 ASA grade III preeclamptic parturients, all planned for Lower Segment Cesarean Section (LSCS).
finding: Subarachnoid blockade is associated with better perioperative hemodynamic stability and a lower risk of hypotension and vasopressor requirements in preeclamptic women compared to normotensive subjects undergoing caesarean section.
cross-section timing: During the perioperative period of lower segment caesarean section (LSCS)
gest_age: Mean gestational age at the time of caesarean section was 39.14+/-0.54 weeks in preeclamptic women and 39.07+/-0.77 weeks in normotensive women.
